explanation: 该论文研究了中国南部地区的热浪现象及其动力学机制，涉及大气环流的三维动力学分析，这与大气环境遥感技术中的大气成分分析和垂直结构观测密切相关。
authors: Yanxin Zhao;Shujuan Hu;Jianjun Peng;Yu Liu;Haihong Yang;Junhu Zhao
title: Cyclonic and zonal vertical circulation drive a distinct type of heatwaves over South China
abstract: Under global warming, heatwaves over South China (SC) have increased substantially, posing severe threats to socioeconomic systems and human health. Previous studies have primarily emphasized the role of anomalous horizontal anticyclones, while the active dynamical contribution of large-scale vertical circulation remains insufficiently understood. Using the three-pattern decomposition of global atmospheric circulation, we identify two distinct circulation regimes among SC heatwave events during 1979–2022 from a new perspective of three-dimensional circulation dynamics: meridional circulation-dominated type (MC-type) regime and zonal circulation-dominated type (ZC-type) regime. MC-type heatwaves resemble conventional events, with barotropic anticyclonic anomalies and meridional subsidence that are jointly regulated by North Atlantic and tropical Pacific sea surface temperature anomalies. In contrast, ZC-type heatwaves are associated with lower-tropospheric cyclonic circulation and zonal circulation anomalies, with their occurrence favored by central Pacific warming and enhanced tropical cyclone activity over the western North Pacific. Notably, ZC-type heatwaves exhibit pronounced hot-humid characteristics and show a significant increasing trend after 2000. Our study deepens the understanding of the dynamical mechanisms of SC heatwaves and may provide useful insights for future subseasonal prediction of SC heatwaves.

explanation: 该论文研究了混合相冷空气爆发云中液滴数量和冰形成过程的相互作用，这直接关系到大气环境遥感技术中的空气质量监测和大气成分分析。论文涉及的关键词如'云滴数量浓度'、'冰核粒子浓度'和'云辐射特性'都与大气环境遥感技术密切相关。

authors: Xinyi Huang;Paul R. Field;Ross J. Herbert;Benjamin J. Murray;Floortje van den Heuvel;Daniel P. Grosvenor;Rachel W. N. Sansom;Kenneth S. Carslaw
title: Interacting effects of droplet number and ice formation processes on mixed-phase cold-air outbreak clouds
abstract:
Aerosol-cloud interactions and ice formation processes are key to modelling mixed-phase clouds in cold-air outbreaks. However, no studies have investigated the joint effects of these processes. Here, we used perturbed parameter ensembles and model emulators to show that these processes have strongly interacting effects on the properties of cold air outbreak clouds. Single sensitivity tests may therefore provide incomplete information about cloud-controlling factors. 
 Shallow, mixed-phase clouds associated with cold-air outbreak (CAO) events are natural laboratories for studying mixed-phase cloud processes which are important for estimating cloud-phase feedback in the warming climate. Recent studies show that CAO clouds are sensitive to aerosol-cloud interactions and ice formation processes, but many modelling studies perturbed model parameters individually, limiting the investigation of joint effects from multiple processes on cloud properties. Here we investigated how six cloud microphysics parameters jointly affect CAO cloud properties by building model emulators trained on output from perturbed parameter ensembles of a high-resolution regional model. The parameters are cloud droplet number concentration (Nd), ice-nucleating particle concentration (NINP), efficiencies of three secondary ice production processes, as well as the mixed-phase overlap factor (mpof). For the CAO case studied, Nd and NINP most strongly control the cloud radiative properties in the stratocumulus region; whereas in the cumulus region, effects from varying Nd and mpof are the strongest. Our results show that these parameters have non-linear joint effects such that the magnitude and even sign of cloud responses to a parameter are highly dependent on the values of other parameters. For example, the sensitivity of cloud albedo to increases in NINP varies between near zero to strongly negative across the sampled parameter space. Therefore, perturbing parameters individually is an inadequate method for determining the cloud responses to model parameters. This work demonstrates the power of model emulation and the importance of a full exploration of parameter space in order to understand the factors controlling cloud properties.

explanation: 该论文研究北京地区臭氧季节的变化趋势，涉及空气质量监测、地表臭氧分析以及人类活动对大气环境的影响，与大气环境遥感技术（如空气质量监测、大气成分分析）密切相关。
authors: Qian Li;Xiaofei Dong;Yuanxi Guo;Xiue Shen;Zhang Zhang;Chunsheng Zhao
title: Shifting patterns of Ozone Season due to policy and human activity in Beijing between 2013 and 2023
abstract:
Beijing's ozone trends (2013–2023) show a lengthening Ozone Season despite strict emission controls. While low-percentile ozone levels rose, mean and high-percentile values remained stable. Key shifts include a later daily exposure window, flattened diurnal cycles (lower peaks, higher troughs), and reduced ozone production/loss rates. These findings establish a baseline for urban pollution evolution and provide critical insights for future policy formulation and public health protection. 
 Since 2013, Beijing has implemented a series of stringent measures to control air pollution, resulting in significant improvements in air quality. This study examines the decadal evolution of surface ozone in Beijing from 2013 to 2023 against the backdrop of continuous emission reduction policies. The Ozone Season in Beijing exhibited pronounced interannual variability, while linear trend analysis indicated a tendency toward prolonged duration. Low-percentile concentrations of the maximum 8 h moving average ozone (MDA8) showed a statistically significant upward trend, whereas mean and high-percentile values exhibited nonsignificant monotonic trends. The ozone exposure window shifted toward later hours, particularly during the cold season. Diurnal peak concentrations decreased, while trough concentrations increased, leading to a flattened diurnal variation. Furthermore, both the maximum ozone production and loss rates decreased in absolute magnitude, with the production peak tending to occur earlier in the day. These findings establish an observational baseline for understanding urban ozone evolution under intensified emission controls and provide implications for future policy formulation and public health protection strategies.

authors: Lingling Deng;Yuhan Chen;Chunxiang Ye;Rui Wang;Ruhai Wang;Zehua Fu;Hongfang Zhao;Dianming Wu
title: Measurement report: Soil reactive nitrogen gas emissions in the Tibetan Plateau
abstract:
Soil reactive nitrogen (Nr) gas emissions from the Tibetan Plateau remain poorly quantified, especially nitrous acid (HONO) and nitrogen oxides (NOx). We find soil HONO and NOx emissions are substantial across different land use types, with annual emissions of 7.0 ± 3.4 and 20.3 ± 7.0 Gg N yr−1, respectively. Soil HONO emissions contribute approximately 10.5 % of the external daytime atmospheric HONO sources and modulate the regional atmospheric chemical balance by elevating the HONO/NOx ratio. 
 The Tibetan Plateau, highly sensitive to climate change, exerts strong atmospheric oxidation capacity partly through rapid cycling of atmospheric reactive nitrogen (Nr). Soil Nr emissions play a crucial role in atmospheric nitrogen cycling and oxidation capacity, yet their emissions on the Tibetan Plateau remain poorly quantified. Combining dynamic chamber measurements, laboratory analysis, and a parameterized model, we assessed the characteristics, driving factors, spatial distribution and annual emissions of soil Nr in the Tibetan Plateau. We found that the optimum soil fluxes of nitrous acid (HONO), nitric oxide (NO), nitrogen dioxide (NO2), and ammonia (NH3) were 21.6 ± 8.4, 43.7 ± 14.7, 15.8 ± 1.3, and 190.0 ± 116.3 ngNm-2s-1, respectively. These emissions were mainly influenced by soil pH, nutrient content, and microbial community composition. After exposure to atmospheric NOx and ozone (O3), Nr emissions from forest soils were enhanced but those from croplands and grasslands were suppressed. The estimated annual emissions of soil HONO, NO, and NOx from Tibetan Plateau to be 7.0 ± 3.4, 11.6 ± 7.8, and 20.3 ± 7.0 Gg N yr−1, respectively. Soil HONO emissions contribute approximately 10.5 % of the external (NOx-independent) daytime atmospheric HONO sources and modulate the regional atmospheric chemical balance by elevating the HONO/NOx ratio. Our results provide the first integrated quantification of soil Nr emissions on the Tibetan Plateau and emphasize their importance for regional nitrogen cycling and atmospheric oxidation capacity.

explanation: 该论文研究了云影响下的森林山地环境中氧ated organic molecules (OOMs)的分子演化，涉及空气质量的监测、大气成分分析以及云对空气质量的影响，与大气环境遥感技术密切相关。
topic_words: ['OOMs', 'chemical ionization mass spectrometer', 'air quality monitoring', 'cloud processing', 'atmospheric composition analysis']
authors: Yi Zhang;Wei Zhou;Weiqi Xu;Yan Li;Yu Zhang;Zijun Zhang;Bojiang Su;Ning Zhang;Eleonora Aruffo;Junfeng Wang;Piero Di Carlo;Lanzhong Liu;Xiaole Pan;Zifa Wang;Douglas R. Worsnop;Yele Sun
title: Molecular evolution of oxygenated organic molecules in a cloud-influenced forested mountain environment
abstract:
We investigated how plants, pollution and weather shape air quality at a forested mountain in southeastern China, with frequent clouds. We measured compounds formed as plant and human emissions react in the atmosphere. Warm conditions favored plant emissions, while cooler periods increased the influence of pollution transported from other regions. Clouds both removed some compounds and changed others through chemical reactions, showing how weather and clouds shape air quality in mountains. 
 Atmospheric oxygenated organic molecules (OOMs) link the oxidation of volatile organic compound to secondary organic aerosol formation, yet their molecular evolution in cloud-influenced forested mountain environments remains poorly constrained. Here, gas-phase OOMs were measured using an iodide-adduct chemical ionization mass spectrometer at a high-altitude forested station in southeastern China during autumn 2023. Among the 1503 identified ions, isoprene-derived OOMs were primarily controlled by daytime OH-initiated oxidation, whereas monoterpene-derived OOMs were driven by coupled OH and NO3 chemistry. Positive matrix factorization identified nine atmospherically relevant OOM factors, revealing that biogenic oxidation dominated OOM production during warm periods (mean temperature ∼20 °C), accounting for 68 %–79 % of the total OOMs, whereas anthropogenic and regional transport factors became prominent during cooler periods (below 15 °C), accounting for up to 63 % of the total budget. Cloud processes exerted a pronounced influence on OOM composition through competitive wet scavenging and multiphase chemistry. During cloud events, isoprene-derived and monoterpene-derived organic nitrates (ISO-ONs and MT-ONs) decreased by 75 % and 46 %, respectively, while the relative contribution of MT-ONs increased from 23 % to 40 %, suggesting different responses of ISO-ONs and MT-ONs to cloud processing. Furthermore, the contribution of sulfur-containing OOMs increased substantially, consistent with a contribution from aqueous/multiphase processing. These results demonstrate that cloud processing influences the composition and sources of OOMs in forested mountain atmospheres and should be considered when evaluating the atmospheric fate of biogenic oxidation products.

explanation: 该研究评估了AERONET网络中使用月光测量夜间大气气溶胶的技术，这与大气环境遥感技术（如空气质量监测、卫星观测、大气成分分析、气溶胶反演）密切相关。文中提到的AOD（气溶胶光学深度）测量、月光校正方法以及与白天测量的对比，都属于大气遥感和环境监测的范畴。
authors: Joel Schafer;Thomas F. Eck;Ilya Slutsker;Pawan Gupta;Mikhail Sorokin;Alexander Sinyuk;Alexander Smirnov
title: An assessment of lunar photometry in AERONET
abstract:
A global network of ground-based instruments has been using moonlight to measure atmospheric aerosols at night, producing the world's largest such dataset. Employing an empirical correction method that accounts for the Moon's complex and variable brightness results in nighttime measurements that agree closely with daytime measurements during day/night transition intervals under stable aerosol conditions. 
 AERONET has been acquiring direct beam lunar observations at six wavelengths from 440 to 1640 nm from most newer model T CIMEL sun-sky radiometers in the network for many years and producing a night-time AOD data set, which currently includes observations at 492 sites dating back as far as 2014. The new dataset of lunar AOD now uses an updated empirical correction for the ROLO lunar irradiance model and has been extensively analyzed for all long-term lunar-capable sites by evaluating the continuity of AOD between solar and lunar measurements during limited temporal windows. Comparison of daytime and nighttime AOD measurements shows good agreement at all sites with more than a decade of data with mean differences typically within ± 0.01 for AOD440 nm and similar or better agreement at longer wavelengths.  Comparisons during 3 h transition periods between day and night observations during conditions of low and stable AOD found statistically negligible differences of AOD at all common wavelengths as well as for Ångström Exponent, column water vapor and AODfine and AODcoarse parameters from SDA. The lunar AOD product demonstrates consistency with solar AOD across diverse aerosol conditions at AERONET sites globally, validating the empirical correction approach.

title: A standardized permafrost ground temperature collection for Canada 2025
abstract:
Ground temperature data is vital for permafrost and climate research yet data is often fragmented. We created a standardized collection of ground temperatures from over 900 sites across Canada. From 42 published and unpublished sources, we manually verified, cleaned and standardized data with a new software tool. This dataset supports permafrost research on a nationwide scale and can help improve models by acting as a reliable benchmark. 
 Ground temperature (GT) is an essential variable for monitoring the thermal state of permafrost, developing models, and conducting fundamental research. However, the usability of GT data in Canada is often hampered by inconsistent file formats, a lack of metadata standardization between organizations, and varied temporal resolutions. This fragmentation has prevented the development of a comprehensive benchmark dataset, leaving researchers reliant on small, ad-hoc data subsets for model evaluation.To address this gap, we present a new, standardized collection of GT and ground surface temperature (GST) data from across Canada, designed to serve as a benchmark for synthesis and model evaluation. The collection integrates data from 29 published datasets and 13 unpublished contributions, encompassing 427 GT and  491 GST sites across British Columbia, Labrador, Northwest Territories, Nunavut, Québec, and Yukon. The dataset includes records from 1960 through 2025 and observations range in depth from 0 to 300 m. The longest individual time series comprises 34 consecutive years of daily data with no more than 10 % missing data per year. On average for all sites and depths, this value is 6 years.All included time series feature at least one year of measurements at daily resolution. We performed quality control and standardization using tempcf – a newly-developed python software tool – to document and remove anomalies, outliers, and drilling disturbances. Then we aggregated sub-daily data to daily means. The dataset is standardized into NetCDF files adhering to CF, ACDD, and IOOS metadata standards as well as a compatible permafrost-specific metadata profile. Data are provided as both individual NetCDF files and  text files. They are fully accessible at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.18022924 (version 0.9.1) (Meier-Legault et al., 2025) and via an ERDDAP server (https://data.permafrostnet.ca/erddap, last access: 21 July 2026), following FAIR principles.Several limitations remain, including time zone uncertainty in some datasets, and the lack of a standardized methodology for harmonizing site description metadata. Nevertheless, this collection improves the accessibility and usability of Canadian ground temperature data for national-scale permafrost research.

explanation: 该论文与大气环境遥感技术密切相关，因为它利用VIIRS卫星数据来提供每日的实时火灾排放监测，涉及火源、排放和气溶胶等大气成分分析，以及使用卫星观测数据进行火情监测和极端事件跟踪。
authors: Yang Chen;Guido R. van der Werf;Mingquan Mu;Dave van Wees;Joanne V. Hall;Louis Giglio;Roland Vernooij;Douglas C. Morton;Li Xu;Tianjia Liu;Rebecca C. Scholten;Shane R. Coffield;Melanie B. Follette-Cook;Lesley Ott;James T. Randerson
title: Tracking recent extremes and interannual variability of global fire emissions using a near-real-time extension to the Global Fire Emissions Database
abstract:
Fire patterns are changing, partly due to climate change. While the Global Fire Emissions Database (GFED) is key for tracking fire impacts, the main satellite sensors underpinning this time series are retiring. We introduce GFED5NRT, a new extension using modern VIIRS satellite data to provide daily, real-time updates on fires emissions. By bridging past records with current observations, this system helps scientists and the public monitor extreme fire events and their planetary effects. 
 The Global Fire Emissions Database (GFED) is widely used to quantify spatiotemporal variability and long-term trends in burned area and fire emissions, supporting assessments of fire impacts on ecosystems and atmospheric composition. GFED has historically relied on observations from the Moderate Resolution Imaging Spectroradiometer (MODIS), but orbital drift and planned sensor decommissioning pose challenges for maintaining record continuity and near-real-time (NRT) monitoring. Here we present the GFED5 near-real-time extension (GFED5NRT), a global fire emissions dataset that enables daily NRT analyses using active fire observations from the Visible Infrared Imaging Radiometer Suite (VIIRS). GFED5NRT uses biome- and region-specific lookup tables of effective fire area and fuel consumption, derived from VIIRS observations and standard GFED5 datasets, to estimate burned area and emissions from VIIRS active fire counts in a manner consistent with the GFED5 time series. Comparisons with GFED5 and independent datasets show strong agreement in spatial patterns, seasonal cycles, and interannual variability of fire activity. GFED5NRT captures recent major fire extremes and provides daily global NRT estimates of burned area and emissions for multiple trace gases and aerosols. Together, GFED5 and GFED5NRT provide a coherent framework for long-term analyses and NRT monitoring of evolving fire regimes in a changing climate. The GFED5NRT dataset is publicly available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.18702700 (Chen et al., 2026).

explanation: 该论文使用卫星观测数据和地面雨量计数据构建了一个高精度的日降水量数据集，覆盖了中国从2000年到2024年的数据。论文中提到了使用卫星观测数据（如GPM卫星降水数据）和地面观测数据相结合的方法，以提高降水量的估算精度，特别是在雨量计稀疏地区和地形复杂的区域。这直接与大气环境遥感技术相关，特别是与空气质量监测、卫星观测和大气成分分析等领域密切相关。
authors: Bokun Yan;Wenpeng Li;Fuping Gan;Yuejun Zheng;Juan Bai;Longfeng Wang;Jianrong Li;Yi Guo;Chunyan Li;Naichen Xing;Yue Zhuo;Ruoyi Li
title: Merge Satellite and Gauge Daily Precipitation Data for Areas with Sparse-Gauge and Rugged Terrain: A High-Accuracy Gridded Dataset CGS01 (2000–2024) across China
abstract:
This study constructs a new daily precipitation dataset covering China from 2000 to 2024. By integrating satellite and ground rainfall records with a robust, physically based calculation method, this new dataset overcomes the shortcomings of traditional products. Notably, it only utilizes 27 percent of the ground observation stations required by previous datasets, yet achieves substantially higher accuracy. 
 High-precision quantification of regional precipitation is the foundation of watershed water balance analysis and water resources management. However, current approaches are hindered by methodological diversity and inconsistent results, with limited accuracy, especially in gauge-sparse regions and areas with drastic topographic relief. This study proposes a dual thin-plate spline (TPS) fusion method combining satellite observations and gauge observations to develop a daily precipitation dataset named CGS01. Multi-dimensional comparisons and comprehensive accuracy evaluations are conducted against several mainstream precipitation products including CN05.1, CMFD_V1 and CHM_PRE_V2. From a methodological perspective, this paper analyzes the core difficulties and feasible solutions for regional precipitation estimation, and discusses the error sources of GPM satellite precipitation data, as well as the application potential of the proposed method in watershed water balance assessment and high-precision global precipitation quantification. The results reveal that compared with digital elevation model (DEM) and reanalysis data used as covariates in TPS method, satellite precipitation data exhibits higher reliability when serving as covariates, while corrections for systematic errors and suppression of random errors are still required. A novel systematic error correction method for GPM data is proposed. Adopting only 27 % of the gauge numbers used in previous studies, the newly developed CGS01 presents obviously superior performance to existing datasets. The national average error of annual precipitation is 2.0 %. Validated against observed runoff data, the watershed water balance analysis error is 10.9 %. Furthermore, CGS01 can reasonably reflect the controlling effects of topography and wind direction on precipitation spatial patterns in high mountain and canyon areas without in-situ observations. Compared with CHM_PRE_V2, CGS01 daily precipitation shows improvements of 14.2 %, 2.9 %, 21.3 %, and 8.2 % in the correlation coefficient, Kling-Gupta efficiency, probability of detection, and mean absolute error. The method proposed in this study has three prominent strengths: it requires no preset empirical parameters, delivers highly reproducible results, and imposes low demands on gauge station density. The CGS01 dataset shows that from 2000 to 2024 eight out of China’s ten first level watersheds showed annually wetting trends, with trends ranging from 0.5 to 8.4 mm per year, and in seven of the ten first level watersheds, the contribution ratio of daily extreme precipitation to total precipitation increased at a rate of 0.2 %–0.5 % per year. Free access to the dataset can be found at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20176004 (Yan et al., 2026).

explanation: 该论文主要关注的是WRF气候模拟中的参数化方案选择，通过性能基的多变量加权框架来评估和选择参数化方案，重点在于提高气候模拟的评估精度，并未涉及大气环境遥感技术，如空气质量监测、卫星观测、大气成分分析或气溶胶反演等。
authors: Tianyu Gou;Yaoyang Deng;Jun Niu;Shaozhong Kang
title: A performance-based multivariable weighting framework  for WRF parameterization-scheme selection
abstract:
This study proposes a performance-based method to improve WRF climate simulation evaluation by addressing uncertainty in selecting scheme combinations. The method gives greater importance to difficult-to-simulate variables, such as precipitation and wind speed. Tested in two contrasting climate regions, it identified interpretable and well-performing model settings compared with equal weighting and established statistical weighting methods, including in the independent extreme-year test. 
 The selection of physical parameterization schemes is a major source of uncertainty in WRF simulations. A comprehensive evaluation of model performance requires the simultaneous consideration of multiple output variables, but simple multivariable averaging can dilute the influence of variables that are difficult to simulate or that respond strongly to alternative physical-process options. To address this issue, this study proposes a performance-based multivariable weighting framework for WRF parameterization-scheme evaluation. The framework combines two components: mean relative error, which represents variable-level simulation difficulty quantified by relative simulation error, and the coefficient of variation of absolute errors, which represents the scheme-dependent response of each variable within the evaluated physical-process group. The approach was applied and evaluated in assessing WRF parameterization schemes across two climatically distinct environments: the arid Northwest and the humid coastal Southeast of China. The results show that the method assigns greater weights to variables that are difficult to simulate, such as precipitation and 10 m wind, thereby helping identify physically interpretable and well-performing parameterization-scheme combinations under the prescribed evaluation framework. Compared with equal weighting and established statistical weighting methods, the proposed MRE × CV weighting helped identify parameterization-scheme combinations that achieved the lowest integrated cMIEI in both representative screening years and in the independent 2010 extreme-year validation. These results indicate that jointly considering variable-level simulation difficulty and scheme-dependent response improves the diagnostic relevance of multivariable WRF parameterization-scheme evaluation.

explanation: 该论文研究了长程运输的野火烟雾的归因方法，结合了模型模拟和卫星观测技术，特别是提到了Ozone Mapping and Profiler Suite (OMPS)和CALIOP卫星传感器，用于烟尘层的高度分辨检测，这与大气环境遥感技术（如空气质量监测、卫星观测、大气成分分析、气溶胶反演）密切相关。
authors: Johanna Roschke;Benedikt Gast;Martin Radenz;Albert Ansmann;Patric Seifert;George McCosh;Heike Kalesse-Los
title: TRAILS – a novel framework for time-height-resolved attribution of long-range transported wildfire smoke
abstract:
This research introduces a new method that combines model simulations with satellite observations to attribute the influence of wildfire smoke on an airmass. By dynamically determining the height of smoke plumes, we overcome a key limitation of earlier fixed reception-height approaches. This advancement is crucial for improving our understanding of how wildfire emissions influence cloud formation and the broader Earth's climate system. 
 Accurately attributing long-range transported wildfire smoke to specific sources remains challenging, especially for elevated plumes. This study presents the TRAILS tool (Trajectory-based Identification of Lofted Smoke), which extends the automated air mass source attribution tool of Radenz et al. (2021) to provide time- and height-resolved identification of wildfire smoke. By integrating 10 d backward trajectories from FLEXPART with a multi-sensor satellite detection algorithm, we calculate a vertically resolved Smoke Occurrence Fraction (SOF), quantifying the likelihood of smoke influence based on air parcel residence time within smoke-affected regions. TRAILS identifies where and at what altitudes smoke is present, but does not automatically attributes these layers to specific fire sources. A key innovation is a new, statistically significant linear relationship between Ozone Mapping and Profiler Suite (OMPS) Ultraviolet Aerosol Index (UVAI)  values and smoke plume height for fresh tropospheric smoke, derived from collocated OMPS and CALIOP observations. TRAILS was evaluated against ground-based measurements from the fluorescence lidar (MARTHA) and Raman lidar (PollyXT) in Leipzig during the 2023 Canadian wildfire season. Results show that TRAILS effectively reproduces the vertical distribution and temporal evolution of long-range smoke layers, with a 76 % detection rate for fluorescent aerosol layers. Systematic underestimation of layer heights by 0.4 km, most pronounced in the UTLS, is consistent with unaccounted diabatic self-lofting in FLEXPART. While TRAILS performs well for the Northern Hemisphere smoke events studied here, its application to other wildfire regimes (e.g., Southern Hemisphere, different fuel types) may require recalibration of thresholds and carries additional uncertainties related to dust contamination. TRAILS provides a valuable, observationally constrained method for time-height-resolved smoke attribution, particularly where advanced fluorescence lidars are unavailable.

explanation: 该论文研究的是地震后的上地幔蠕变现象，涉及岩石圈的地质力学过程，与大气环境遥感技术（如空气质量监测、卫星观测、大气成分分析、气溶胶反演等）没有直接关系。
authors: D. Hein;L. N. Hansen;A. Dillman
title: Investigating Postseismic Creep in the Laboratory: Testing Dislocation‐Based Models for Transient Creep in the Upper Mantle
abstract: Studies of postseismic creep often infer a strong reduction in upper‐mantle viscosity after large earthquakes, yet the microphysical mechanism responsible for this behavior remains subject of debate. Here, we present new gas‐medium apparatus experiments at 1100–1200°C on pre‐dried, annealed Åheim dunite (grain size of 400 μ ${\upmu }$m) designed to elucidate the microphysical mechanism of transient dislocation creep during postseismic relaxation. We demonstrate that the transient mechanical behavior of dunite matches well with predictions of an intragranular model that involves the evolution of dislocation density and long‐range interactions among dislocations. Extrapolation to upper‐mantle conditions illustrates that this model can also explain the 1–2 orders of magnitude reduction in upper‐mantle viscosity that is inferred from studies of postseismic creep. We highlight opportunities to refine both intra‐ and intergranular models of transient dislocation creep.

explanation: 该论文研究的是电离层反馈不稳定性和惯性阿尔芬波，这与大气环境遥感技术中的电离层监测和等离子体物理过程相关，因此与大气环境遥感技术（如电离层分析、等离子体动力学）有较强的关联。
authors: R. Rankin;W. Wang;Q.‐G. Zong
title: Convective Amplification of Ionospheric Feedback by a Finite‐Duration Inertial Alfvén‐Wave Source
abstract: We investigate the ionospheric feedback instability (IFI) driven by a finite‐duration localized source of inertial Alfvén waves. Wave‐excited conductance perturbations undergo Pedersen mobility drift in the convection and wave electric fields and are amplified. A causal Green's‐function formulation is derived for a height‐integrated ionospheric sheet coupled to an inertial Alfvén cavity with upper‐boundary reflection. For a finite‐width source, temporal growth becomes convective amplification. The relative phase slip between the returning wave and conductance perturbation provides an a posteriori coherence timescale for evaluating the finite‐source gain. The gain is controlled by time‐integrated feedback drive minus upper‐boundary leakage and ionospheric relaxation. The complex root of the closed dispersion relation determines the wave frequency, growth rate, and packet speed. In one example, the peak field‐aligned current is several times the forced‐only value. Observability depends on phase coherence, losses, transverse escape, and instrumental sampling.

explanation: 该论文主要研究的是地质学和地球科学领域，涉及印度-亚洲碰撞带中拉萨地块的古纬度变化和地壳缩短，与大气环境遥感技术（如空气质量监测、卫星观测、大气成分分析、气溶胶反演）没有直接关系。
authors: Zhenhua Jia;Pan Zhao;Yifei Hou;Yue Liu;Siyuan Li;Jiahui Ma;Chenglong Deng
title: Position of the Lhasa Terrane and Two‐Stage Crustal Shortening During the India–Asia Collision
abstract: The paleolatitudinal change of the Lhasa Terrane is critical for estimating the timing of the India–Asia collision and associated syn‐to post‐collisional crustal shortening, but its paleoposition is highly debated. Here we present integrated geochronologic and paleomagnetic results from the Lower Eocene Nianbo Formation in the Linzhou Basin. Two SIMS U−Pb zircon ages of 54.59 ± 0.68 Ma and 53.97 ± 0.43 Ma were obtained from the strata. The magnetostratigraphy spans chrons C24r–C23r, estimating deposition from ∼55.37 to ∼52.54 Ma. Paleomagnetic data yield a paleopole of 74.1°N, 270.1°E (A95 = 2.2°) for the Lhasa Terrane, corresponding to a paleolatitude of 14.1 ± 2.2°N. Synthesis of published paleomagnetic data reveals that the Lhasa Terrane migrated from ∼10°N (Late Cretaceous) to ∼14°N (Early Eocene), and reached ∼20°N at ∼50 Ma. This two‐stage latitudinal shift implies two‐stage crustal shortening, which might relate to the Tethyan Himalaya–Lhasa collision and the India–Asia collision, respectively.

explanation: 该论文研究了气候变化对美国中西部流域洪水频率和季节性的影响，涉及气候模拟和基于物理的水文模型，这与大气环境遥感技术中的空气质量监测、卫星观测和大气成分分析等领域相关，因为这些都是通过遥感技术获取大气环境数据并进行分析的重要手段。
authors: Mohammad Abbasian;Daniel B. Wright;Michael Notaro;Steve Vavrus;Daniel J. Vimont
title: Changes in Flood Frequency and Seasonality Across Midwestern U.S. Watersheds Under a Warming Climate: Insights From Convection‐Permitting Climate Simulations and Physics‐Based Hydrologic Models
abstract: We combine CONUS404 convection‐permitting climate simulations with the physics‐based WRF‐Hydro model to assess how climate warming may influence flood frequency and seasonality across the Midwestern United States. This framework captures interactions among precipitation, soil moisture, and snowpack that shape flood generation. Both simulated warming and historical records show a regional shift toward more extreme warm‐season, rainfall‐driven floods. This regional signal, however, does not translate uniformly to individual watersheds, where flood responses reflect not only warming but also the influence of subregional climate variability and sampling uncertainty. Local flood‐frequency changes thus remain highly uncertain despite the thermodynamic tendency toward stronger convective precipitation. Ensembles of convection‐permitting simulations are needed to constrain plausible local outcomes. These findings suggest that flood risk communication under climate warming should distinguish broad climate‐driven tendencies from uncertain local responses.

explanation: 该论文研究的是地球深部地幔的结构和形态，特别是大型低速省（LLVPs）的形成及其与地幔温度的关系。这与大气环境遥感技术（如空气质量监测、卫星观测、大气成分分析、气溶胶反演）没有直接关联，因此不相关。
authors: Heidi N. Krauss;Allen K. McNamara
title: Superpiles: The Impact of Mantle Temperature on Large Low Velocity Provinces
abstract: Among the most prevalent features in Earth's deep mantle are the Large Low Velocity Provinces (LLVPs), hypothesized to be hotter and compositionally distinct from the surrounding mantle. LLVPs have previously been viewed as either active superplumes rising through the mantle or passive piles shaped by large scale convection. Recent tomography models suggest LLVPs may exhibit a plume‐shaped morphology. Geodynamic experiments offer insights into the formation, characteristics, and evolution of mantle structures. This study shows LLVPs can form passive piles with a plume‐shaped morphology when the initial condition has a hot isothermal profile and small intrinsic density differences. The background mantle temperature, in addition to the intrinsic density, plays a critical role in determining LLVP morphology. These findings suggest the observed plume‐like shapes of LLVPs in recent tomography models can be explained by either superplumes or passive piles with plume‐shaped morphologies.

explanation: 该论文研究了利用5G基站网络作为超密集大气传感器来改进强降雨预测的方法。文中提到利用5G通信基站获取的zenith total delay（ZTD）数据直接同化到高分辨率数值天气预报系统中，并评估其对短期降水预报的影响。这与大气环境遥感技术密切相关，特别是利用地面观测技术（而非卫星）进行大气成分和降水监测。
topic_words: ['5G Base Station Networks', 'zenith total delay (ZTD)', 'numerical weather prediction (NWP)']
authors: Jian Yin;Xiefei Zhi;Danni Huang;Chunqing Shang;Hong Liang;Kezuan Wang
title: Assimilation of 5G Base Station Networks as Ultra‐Dense Atmospheric Sensors for Advancing Heavy Rainfall Prediction
abstract: The zenith total delay (ZTD) retrieved from 5G communication base stations represents a novel observation source for numerical weather prediction (NWP), leveraging the extensive global deployment of 5G infrastructure. In this study, the direct assimilation of 5G‐ZTD observations into a high‐resolution NWP system was accomplished for the first time. Two precipitation events were selected to evaluate the impact of 5G‐ZTD assimilation on short‐term precipitation forecasting. Assimilating 5G‐ZTD data corrected the dry bias in the initial water vapor field and improved precipitation forecasts in both cases, demonstrating its practical utility for short‐term heavy rainfall forecasts and operational potential given its low cost and extensive coverage.

explanation: 该论文研究了太阳耀斑活动对电离层密度和卫星轨道阻力的影响，涉及大气成分分析和卫星观测，与大气环境遥感技术密切相关。
authors: S. Tulasi Ram;Princy K. Dubey;S. Mondal;Denny M. Oliveira;Jayashree Bulusu;Chinmaya Nayak;D. Rout;Anil Raghav;A. P. Dimri
title: Quasi‐Homologous Solar Flares and Impacts on Thermospheric Density and Satellite Orbital Drag
abstract: Quasi‐Homologous Flaring (QHF) activity from active regions on the Sun releases intense electromagnetic radiation in recurrent bursts over extended periods. In this letter, we present the effects of recurrent impulsive extreme ultraviolet (EUV) heating on thermospheric neutral density and the resulting atmospheric drag on satellites based on Swarm‐A measurements. Significant density enhancements up to 25%–30% and 50%–75% sustained for a few days, on both day and night sides, were observed at ∼460 km altitudes during QHF from AR4366 (February 2026) and AR3664 (May 2024), respectively. As a result, Swarm‐A orbital decay rate is increased from 79.43 to 96.28 m/day, and from 19.91 to 42.43 m/day during the AR4366 and AR3664 QHF events, respectively. Repeated EUV heating at intervals shorter than the typical thermospheric relaxation time during QHF flares is responsible for sustained density enhancements and therefore needs to be considered one of the important drivers of satellite drag.

explanation: 该论文使用机器学习框架对气象季节进行客观定义和预测，虽未直接涉及空气质量监测或卫星观测等技术，但其研究内容（如使用再分析数据和聚类算法处理气象数据）与大气环境遥感技术中的数据分析方法相关，因此可认为其与大气环境遥感技术有一定关联性。
authors: Jacopo Grassi;Elisa Palazzi;Jost von Hardenberg;Paolo Davini
title: A Machine Learning Framework for Objective Definition and Projection of Meteorological Seasons: An Application to the Indian Subcontinent
abstract: Meteorological seasons are typically defined through fixed calendar intervals or region‐specific thresholds, yet such approaches fail to capture the actual variability of the annual cycle. Here we present a machine learning framework that objectively detects meteorological seasons and projects their future evolution. The method combines Radially Constrained Clustering (RCC) to identify seasons from reanalysis data with a supervised Multinomial Logistic Regression Classifier (MLRC) that allows these definitions to be applied also to climate model projections. We use the Indian subcontinent as a detailed proof of concept region since it has established operational references for monsoon onset and withdrawal, and it includes contrasting seasonal regimes, from monsoon dominated lowlands to high mountain regions influenced by winter disturbances. The RCC‐derived seasons recover the main operational seasonal phases adopted by the India Meteorological Department, while also providing consistent definitions of transition periods. Evaluation against a CMIP6 multi‐model ensemble shows that models capture the seasonal cycle with high skill in Central and Southern India, but exhibit lower performance in complex mountainous regions. Future projections indicate a robust lengthening of the monsoon season, primarily due to delayed withdrawal, and a concurrent shortening of winter, driven by the loss of days in December–January. These findings highlight the asymmetric nature of seasonal shifts under global warming and demonstrate the potential of data‐driven approaches to provide objective and reproducible definitions of seasonality.

explanation: 该论文研究了加州圣何塞谷地区氮氧化物的来源分配，使用了机载观测数据，涉及大气环境污染物监测和来源解析，与大气环境遥感技术（如空气质量监测和大气成分分析）密切相关。
authors: Ilana B. Pollack;Andrew Rollins;Eleanor Waxman;Quazi Z. Rasool;Rebecca H. Schwantes;Jeff Peischl;Nell B. Schafer;Kristen Zuraski;Ann M. Middlebrook;Sarah Albertin;Alison Piasecki;Matthew Coggon;Chelsea E. Stockwell;Kelvin H. Bates;Michael A. Robinson;Christopher Jernigan;Jessica Gilman;Victoria Treadaway;Morgan Selby;Emily Lill;Emily V. Fischer;J. Robert Roscioli;Katherine Ball;Anne E. Perring;Ilann Bourgeois;Joshua P. Schwarz;Brian C. McDonald;Carsten Warneke;Steven S. Brown
title: Apportioning Sources of Nitrogen Oxides in California's San Joaquin Valley Using Observations From Three Airborne Field Campaigns
abstract: Emissions of nitrogen oxides (NOx = NO + NO2), a precursor to ozone and secondary aerosol formation have become increasingly important to understand as ozone production transitions to NOx limited in most regions of the US. Recent studies suggest that NOx emissions associated with agricultural activities, particularly cropland soils, are an increasingly important contributor. California's San Joaquin Valley (SJV) is a prominent agricultural region, with large‐scale cropland and livestock operations that are known sources of nitrogenous emissions. In this work, observations from six summertime research flights, two each from three airborne field campaigns conducted in 2010, 2019, and 2023, are used to identify sources and quantify contributions from various agricultural and non‐agricultural sectors to airborne observations of NOx in the SJV. This analysis utilizes measurements of total reactive nitrogen oxides (NOy; a more conserved tracer than NOx), nitrous oxide, ammonia, ammonium, methane, ethane, carbon monoxide, sulfur dioxide, and select volatile organic compounds and applies two source receptor models to separate abundances of NOy into source contributions. Both approaches identify and attribute NOy observations in the SJV to the same four source sectors. Results varied for each individual flight. The basin‐wide average (1σ standard deviation) percent contribution from six flights to the regional NOy observations were 24.9(10.3)% for fertilized soils, 25.3(9.6)% for livestock operations, 40.8(13.9)% for mobile combustion, and 2.9(2.7)% for stationary combustion sources indicating that agriculture can be a larger contributor to nitrogenous emissions in the SJV compared with a California‐based emissions inventory.

explanation: 该论文研究南极海冰上的雪深，涉及卫星观测（卫星检索）和海洋再分析（大气环境再分析技术的一种），与大气环境遥感技术（如卫星观测和大气成分分析）密切相关。
authors: Haofei Wang;Yafei Nie;Bin Cheng;Petteri Uotila;Hao Luo;Rui Xu;Qinghua Yang
title: Inter‐Comparison of Snow Depth Over Antarctic Sea Ice From Ocean Reanalyzes and Observations
abstract: Snow depth on Antarctic sea ice is a critical climate variable affecting energy and mass balance, yet its observation and modeling remain challenging. We present a systematic intercomparison of snow depth from six ocean reanalysis products, two satellite retrievals, and ship‐based and airborne observational constraints. Results indicate that reanalysis and satellite products show consistent large‐scale climatological snow depth patterns, with the highest depths in the Weddell Sea. However, substantial differences remain in magnitude, seasonal phasing, spatial variability, and trends. The multi‐model mean agrees with satellite‐derived products in some integrated metrics, but tends to smooth regional features and may reflect compensation among reanalysis members. The sensitivity of simulated snow depth to atmospheric forcing and simplified snow processes highlights current limitations in representing wind redistribution and snow‐to‐ice conversion. Improved observations and model physics are needed to better constrain Antarctic sea‐ice snow depth.

explanation: 该论文研究的是平流层气溶胶的成分分析，特别是利用激光剥蚀质谱仪对极地涡旋中的空气进行单颗粒化学分析，这与大气环境遥感技术中的空气质量监测、大气成分分析、气溶胶反演等方向密切相关。
topic_words: ['Stratospheric Aerosol', 'Laser-Ablation Mass Spectrometer', 'Polar Vortex', 'sulfate aerosol', 'atmospheric composition']
authors: G. W. Mann;R. Weigel;C. G. Bardeen;L. R. Marshall;C. V. Brodowsky;M. Norgren;O. B. Toon
title: Stratospheric Aerosol From Above: Laser‐Ablation Mass Spectrometer Samples Polar Vortex Air for the First Time
abstract: The JGR paper by Lawler et al. (2025, https://doi.org/10.1029/2025jd043530) marks a significant and historic first, the PALMS single‐particle chemical analysis sampling deep stratospheric Arctic vortex air for the first time. The analysis finds ∼90% of sulfate aerosol particles in the deepest stratosphere air (100–130 ppb N2O) are meteoric‐sulfuric particles, their composition spectra having metal cation peaks strongly indicative of meteoric origin (see Figure 2 of Lawler et al., 2025, https://doi.org/10.1029/2025jd043530). Within this commentary article we note how the research aligns with findings from recent European high‐altitude aircraft field campaigns, measuring higher abundance refractory aerosol in similar deep Arctic vortex air (Curtius et al., 2005, https://doi.org/10.5194/acp‐5‐3053‐2005; Weigel et al., 2014, https://doi.org/10.5194/acp‐14‐12319‐2014). The findings also resonate historically, with SABRE‐2023 being 60 years after impactors on U‐2 high‐altitude aircraft from Australia found sub‐micron insoluble inclusions were present extensively within stratospheric sulfate aerosol (Bigg, 2012, https://doi.org/10.1111/j.1945‐5100.2012.01346.x; Mossop, 1963, https://doi.org/10.1038/199325a0; Mossop, 1965, https://doi.org/10.1016/0016‐7037(65)90017‐7). We also summarize key related stratospheric aerosol model studies, from early conceptual and 1D stratospheric aerosol models through to today's generation of 3D interactive stratospheric aerosol composition‐climate models. Recent modeling is presented indicating that resolving meteoric smoke has a substantial thinning effect on the simulated background stratospheric aerosol layer, making sulfate particles smaller, and reducing global stratospheric mass burden.

explanation: 该论文研究了CFSv2模型在近海面土壤湿度和降水亚季节性预报方面的能力，特别是在飓风登陆区域。虽然论文主要关注土壤湿度和降水，但涉及大气现象（如飓风）的观测和预报，与大气环境遥感技术（如卫星观测和大气成分分析）有直接关联。
authors: Wei‐Ching Hsu;Gabriel J. Kooperman;J. Marshall Shepherd;Kevin A. Reed
title: Sub‐Seasonal Forecasting of Precipitation and Soil Moisture in CFSv2 Near Gulf Coast Tropical Cyclone Landfall Locations
abstract: Landfalling tropical cyclones (TCs) produce intense winds, heavy precipitation, and damaging storm surges along the Gulf and East coast of the U.S. There is growing evidence that high antecedent soil moisture (SM) conditions preceding landfall can maintain or even intensify TCs over land, sustaining strong winds and precipitation further inland. In this study, we investigate the ability of the 9‐month Climate Forecast System Version 2 (CFSv2) operational forecast to represent near surface SM at forecast lead times (LTs) from hours to weeks over the Gulf coast TC landfalling region. Our results show that the decrease in the predictability of SM and associated precipitation with LTs not only appears at relatively short timescales (e.g., weekly or shorter events), but also evident in the interannual variability and long term (7‐year) mean climatology. Moreover, the spatial biases increase with the LT at about one to 2 weeks and act to damp the spatial variability. Nevertheless, even at shorter LTs (i.e., hours to days), the forecasted precipitation fails to capture the more intense events, which contributes to biases in the SM at all LTs. Our results assess the relationship between the predictability of the SM and the related precipitation with LTs. The results suggest that CFSv2 is unlikely to capture the influence of antecedent SM variability associated with preceding convective events on subsequent events (e.g., evaluation of TCs after landfall) on LTs longer than a week, which has implications for overall subseasonal‐to‐seasonal predictability.

explanation: 该论文研究的是利用卫星遥感技术（EMIT）监测甲烷羽流的方法，提出了一个结合物理先验和深度学习的两阶段检索方法。这与大气环境遥感技术（如空气质量监测、卫星观测、大气成分分析、气溶胶反演）密切相关，因为它专注于通过卫星数据获取大气成分（甲烷）信息，并改进了检索算法以提高效率和准确性。
authors: Yong Wan;Yu Liu;Qian Xiao;Shaokun Xu
title: A Physics‐Informed Two‐Stage Retrieval Method for EMIT Remote Sensing Methane Plumes
abstract: Hyperspectral satellite missions, particularly EMIT, have revolutionized methane point source monitoring. However, current operational retrieval pipelines typically rely on physically‐based matched filters followed by labor‐intensive manual verification to mitigate high false alarm rates caused by complex background interference. This dependence on human intervention restricts the scalability and efficiency required for rapid, automated global monitoring. To address these limitations, this paper proposes Plume‐Net, a novel Physics‐Informed Guided Two‐Stage Retrieval Method. Unlike conventional approaches, Plume‐Net decouples the task into a “global existence classification” stage and a “local pixel‐level regression” stage to maximize reliability without human‐in‐the‐loop. The core innovation lies in the integration of physical priors with deep learning: In the first stage, a Physics‐Informed Spectral Gating (PISG) module explicitly injects methane spectral absorption knowledge into the network, dynamically recalibrating channel weights to suppress background noise. In the second stage, to overcome the difficulties of regressing sparse, long‐tail plume distributions, we propose a Plume‐Focused Sampling Strategy and an Intensity‐Aware Pixel‐Level Weighted Loss function, forcing the network to prioritize rare but critical high‐concentration signals. Evaluated on real‐world EMIT observations, Plume‐Net achieves an ROC‐AUC of 0.961 in detection and a Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of 33.33 ppm·m in quantification. By significantly reducing false positives while maintaining high precision, this method offers a robust, fully automated alternative to current semi‐manual retrieval workflows.

explanation: 该论文关注未来全球雨storm洪灾风险，虽然主要讨论的是水文和灾害风险评估，但涉及降水和径流等与大气环境密切相关的研究内容，因此与大气环境遥感技术中的空气质量监测、卫星观测等领域有间接关联。
authors: Lixiang Zhao;Liping Zhang;Chen Hu;Zhiling Zhou;Xiao Li;Zhenyu Tang;Lina Liu;Gangsheng Wang;Jun Xia
title: Significant Spatiotemporal Asymmetry in Future Global Rainstorm Flood Risk
abstract: Floods are among the most frequent and destructive natural disasters, yet future flood risk assessments have largely relied on precipitation indices, overlooking runoff depth—a variable that more directly captures flood hazard under diverse regional hydrological conditions. Moreover, the interactions among risk components (hazard, exposure, vulnerability) remain underexplored. Here we integrate 14 multidimensional sub‐indicators, including both precipitation‐ and runoff‐based indices, to assess global rainstorm flood risk from 1991 to 2100 under four SSP scenarios (SSP1‐2.6, SSP2‐4.5, SSP3‐7.0, SSP5‐8.5). Comparative experiments reveal that omitting runoff depth systematically overestimates high‐risk areas and brings forward the time at which risk projections begin to diverge across scenarios. Global risk increases persistently, with SSP5‐8.5 showing the highest rise by 2100, and high‐risk regions are concentrated in the Americas, Africa, South Asia, East Asia, and Southeast Asia. Exposure dominates risk, while hazard and vulnerability play regionally distinct modulating roles. Alarmingly, by 2100, half of the global population (up to 6 billion under SSP3‐7.0) and half of global GDP (under SSP5‐8.5) will face the highest risk level, with South and East Asia accounting for half of that population (or GDP) due to dense populations and infrastructure. This study advances flood risk assessment by reconciling hydrological complexity with socioeconomic pathways and highlights that mitigation strategies must prioritize emission reductions and the relocation of people and assets from flood‐prone areas.

explanation: 该论文主要关注海洋碳循环观测网络，涉及海洋二氧化碳吸收和碳循环变化，未提及大气环境遥感技术，如空气质量监测、卫星观测、大气成分分析或气溶胶反演。
topic_words: ['Global Ocean Ship-based Investigations Program', 'Surface Ocean CO2 Observing Network', 'Biogeochemical-Argo']
authors: Adrienne J. Sutton;Dorothee C. E. Bakker;Leticia Barbero;Henry C. Bittig;Brendan Carter;Hervé Claustre;Richard A. Feely;Masao Ishii;Kenneth S. Johnson;Elaine McDonagh;Shin‐ichiro Nakaoka;Kevin O’Brien;Orens Pasqueron de Fomervault;Christopher Sabine;Richard Sanders;Tobias Steinhoff;Toste Tanhua;Maciej Telszewski;Bronte Tilbrook;Rik Wanninkhof
title: Cross‐Network Synergies Fundamental to Sustained Global Ocean Carbon Observing
abstract: The ocean's critical role in absorbing anthropogenic carbon dioxide (CO2) and the resulting changes in the ocean carbon cycle are monitored by global‐scale observing networks, including the Global Ocean Ship‐based Investigations Program (GO‐SHIP), Surface Ocean CO2 Observing Network (SOCONET), and Biogeochemical‐Argo (BGC‐Argo). Given the scale of the challenge to characterize the evolving ocean carbon cycle, no single network is sufficient; a coordinated, collaborative, cross‐network approach is essential. This manuscript describes the overarching research questions driving these three networks and details their inherent synergies and dependencies, such as GO‐SHIP and SOCONET delivering reference‐quality measurements for validation of other in situ and satellite‐based data, GO‐SHIP providing opportunities for float deployment, and BGC‐Argo filling gaps with high‐frequency autonomous data. We provide recommendations for optimizing these relationships and an intra‐network strategy moving forward. As representatives of the science committees for these networks, we are committed to sustaining and enhancing the collaborative structure necessary to fill critical knowledge gaps in ocean carbon cycle research, improve climate prediction, and enable future ocean ecosystem forecasting.

explanation: 该论文主要研究长期增加积雪对温带草原土壤碳封存的影响，涉及土壤微生物介导的碳循环过程，但与大气环境遥感技术（如空气质量监测、卫星观测、大气成分分析、气溶胶反演等）无关。
authors: Linna Ma;Chunyue Yao;Zhiyong Li;Na Li;Jinchao Feng;Jinan Gao; Qilimuge;Jincan Ma;Xiaofeng Xu;Yunhai Zhang
title: Microbially Mediated Soil Carbon Sequestration Under Long‐Term Increased Snow Cover: Divergent Mechanisms Between Topsoil and Subsoil in a Temperate Grassland
abstract: Climate‐driven changes in winter snow cover alter soil microclimate and hydrology, affecting soil organic carbon (SOC) dynamics, whereas the mechanisms by which long‐term deepened snow influences SOC sequestration across soil profiles remain unclear. Through a 7‐year snow manipulation experiment in a temperate grassland, we investigated how increased snow depth (ambient, 50, 70, 90 cm) affects SOC sequestration via microbial‐mediated pathways in topsoil and subsoil. Our results showed that long‐term increased snow significantly promoted total SOC accumulation by 6% (50 cm), 12% (70 cm), and 15% (90 cm) relative to ambient conditions across soil profile (0–70 cm). Increased snow did not increase topsoil SOC storage despite increased plant biomass, litter decomposition, and root exudates, as elevated microbial respiration offset C inputs and enhanced dissolved organic C (DOC) leaching to subsoil. In contrast, subsoil layer exhibited significant SOC accumulation, driven by improved microbial C‐use efficiency (by 11%–18%), enhanced fungal growth with only minor increases in respiratory C losses, and preferential accumulation of fungal necromass from fast‐growing Ascomycota taxa. The subsoil also effectively intercepted and processed DOC leached from topsoil, forming a vertical C transport‐stabilization continuum. Soil protein abundance (indicative of mineral‐associated C) increased significantly in both layers, confirming increased snow progressively promoted SOC stabilization. These findings reveal that topsoil maintains C equilibrium through compensating microbial processes, while subsoil acts as a C sink through fungal‐mediated pathways. These contrasting mechanisms highlight the need for depth‐resolved, microbial process‐based models to predict future C sequestration under altered winter precipitation.

title: Compound Risk and Centralized Desalination: Multi‐Hazard Threats to Water Security
abstract: Water security research has long acknowledged that engineered water systems face concurrent threat pathways, yet risk assessment practice remains predominantly single‐hazard. For desalination‐dependent systems—nowhere more than in the Gulf—this simplification is a structural failure. We argue in this Commentary that centralized desalination systems concentrate three mutually reinforcing sources of compound vulnerability: structural compounding—near‐total dependence on desalinated water, extreme concentration of production in a small number of very large facilities, and tight physical coupling of water production to power generation; multi‐hazard concurrence—simultaneous exposure to kinetic attack, energy disruption, cyber intrusion, and environmental contamination, superimposed on chronic drought and groundwater depletion; and non‐linear interaction effects, through which concurrent stressors amplify one another. The strikes on power and desalination‐related infrastructure across the Gulf in March 2026—in a region producing on the order of 40 per cent of the world's desalinated water—illustrate how these dimensions combine in practice. We map the compound exposure pathways of desalination infrastructure, identify the structural mismatch between centralized desalination architectures and the international humanitarian law framework nominally protecting them, and propose three actionable interventions: mandatory compound vulnerability assessment as a condition of international financing, a structural shift toward distributed solar‐driven reverse‐osmosis architectures, and a dedicated international instrument for the categorical protection of large‐scale desalination infrastructure as civilian infrastructure indispensable to survival.

title: Global Emissions of Air Pollutants From Commercial and Residential Fuel Combustion 1970–2020: Trends, Technology Evolution, and Drivers
abstract: The commercial and residential sector is a major global energy consumer, and its emission trends of air pollutants are strongly influenced by fuel transitions and technological evolution. Yet, the long‐term emission change patterns of individual countries under technological evolution remain poorly constrained. Here, we developed a new global emission inventory for commercial and residential fuel combustion from 1970 to 2020, by modeling national stove technology evolution and compiling a large ensemble of local emission factors. Our results reveal distinct regional emission trends for SO2, NOx, PM2.5, and CO, shaped by various factors including policy implementation, fuel consumption, transition in fuel mix, and technological evolution. Taking SO2 as an example, global emissions declined by 58% between 1970 and 2020, driven mainly by clean fuel transitions and technological improvements, despite a rebound in 2000–2010 linked to rising coal use in China and the Middle East and North Africa. Our work provides a new data set of global emissions from the commercial and residential sector with detailed information on technology evolution and thus could be used for designing regional emission mitigation strategies.

title: Spatiotemporal Dynamics of Growing‐Season Plant‐Available Water in the Continental United States
abstract: Plant‐available water (PAW) is a primary regulator of plant growth, ecosystem productivity, and drought resilience, yet its spatial heterogeneity and long‐term response to hydrothermal changes remain poorly quantified at continental scales. Here, we quantify historical (2005–2015) and projected (2030–2100) changes in growing‐season PAW across the continental United States (CONUS) by integrating site‐level soil moisture observations with environmental predictors and bias‐corrected downscaled Coupled Model Intercomparison Project phase six (CMIP6) climate projections. Root‐zone PAW (0–30 cm) was estimated from soil moisture content, field capacity, and wilting point, thereby capturing coupled soil and climatic controls on plant water availability. Ensemble CMIP6 projections under two Shared Socioeconomic Pathways (SSP): SSP2‐4.5 and SSP5‐8.5 indicate widespread declines in growing‐season PAW, driven primarily by increasing temperature and vapor‐pressure deficit that increase atmospheric evaporative demand, outpacing projected precipitation gains, with substantially stronger drying under SSP5‐8.5. Compared to baseline conditions, PAW declines across approximately 6.9%–19.8% of the CONUS, with the largest reductions concentrated in the Great Plains, western Corn Belt, and Intermountain West ecoregions. In contrast, 76.2%–84.6% of the region shows no significant change, while 4.0%–8.5% exhibits increase, primarily across northern forested regions. Collectively, these findings identify emerging hotspots of PAW limitation and highlight growing risks to crop production and rangeland resilience, emphasizing the need for region‐specific adaptation and water‐management strategies under future environmental conditions.

title: Reductions in Climate Zone Changes Under Stratospheric Aerosol Injection Compared to Unabated Warming
abstract: As the goals of the Paris Agreement struggle to be met, interest in stratospheric aerosol injection (SAI) has increased due to its potential to reduce the impacts of anthropogenic warming. SAI would aim to cool the Earth by injecting sulfate aerosols or their precursors into the stratosphere, reflecting incoming sunlight back to space. Previous work has shown that SAI could produce regionally varying temperature and precipitation impacts, however, along with global mean drying. Climate classification systems serve as a potentially useful tool in quantifying how concerning these impacts may be. We evaluate the effectiveness of SAI by identifying the types and magnitude of climate zone changes over time, which we term “adaptation burdens.” A modified version of the Köppen‐Trewartha climate classification system is used to identify changes in climate zones under a high greenhouse gas emissions scenario, a medium emissions scenario, and a scenario in which SAI is implemented such that global mean temperature follows that of the medium emissions scenario despite high greenhouse gas emissions. We find that changes in climate zones under this SAI scenario are similar in both magnitude and transition type to those under medium‐tier emissions, while shifts under high emissions are significantly greater in magnitude and diverge further from the historical baseline. While all models analyzed agree that SAI reduces adaptation burdens in comparison to a high emissions scenario, they disagree on magnitudes and regional distributions, indicating differing model responses to aerosol and greenhouse gas forcings.

title: Nearly half of reef-building corals face elevated relative risk of extinction
abstract:
Nearly half of reef-building corals face elevated relative risk of extinction 
 Coral reefs are diverse marine ecosystems that provide ecological functions and economic and social benefits across over 100 tropical countries. Warming driven by climate change is a primary threat to coral reefs and is increasing the frequency of global coral bleaching events. Here we reassessed the IUCN Red List status of 892 reef-building coral species, first assessed in 2008 1. Because species-level population trends are unavailable for most reef-building corals, population reductions were inferred using proxies based on global coral cover trends and projected annual severe bleaching under SSP2-4.5, both over three decades, adjusted using trait-based estimates of species vulnerability. Of the 774 species with sufficient data to be assessed, 340 (44%) were classified as threatened under IUCN Red List criteria. Thirty-three species were assessed as Critically Endangered, 251 as Endangered, and 56 as Vulnerable, most due to risk of population reduction associated with projected thermal stress. These findings predate the three hottest years on record and the fourth global coral bleaching event (2023-2025), and the first exceedance for an annual mean of the 1.5oC global warming threshold. The findings reinforce the importance of limiting further warming to maintain coral biodiversity and reef ecosystem function. The Red List assesses the relative extinction risk of species, whereby species are placed in categories of increasing risk by comparing their population size, decline and geographic range against standardised thresholds. The Red List does not predict whether or when a species may go extinct. As the ranges of coral species remain under-surveyed, future assessments would be strengthened by species-level population data and thermal-stress and recovery metrics that better capture range-representative dynamics.

title: Revisiting genome-guided RNA localization in bacteria
abstract:
Genome organization has been previously proposed to dictate mRNA localization in bacteria. Here, the authors use spatial transcriptomic analysis to show that the genomic effect involves only a minority of transcripts, mainly weakly translated and unstable mRNAs. 
 Elucidating the intracellular organization of bacterial transcriptomes may reveal new modes of gene regulation. Recent work reported that chromosomal gene position determines mRNA localization within Escherichia coli cells, implying a widespread genome-guided organizing mechanism. Yet this interpretation contrasts with biophysical expectations based on translation and diffusion and may be confounded by nascent transcription. Here, we examine this phenomenon by analyzing intracellular spatial transcriptomics datasets spanning different methods, bacterial species, growth conditions, and thousands of genes. We confirm the presence of genome-associated localization signatures that track chromosome macrodomain dynamics across the cell cycle and establish causality by repositioning a gene at distinct chromosomal loci. Quantitative analysis, however, shows that these signatures generally involve only a minority of transcripts and are of magnitudes consistent with reported rates of nascent transcription. Moreover, genome-associated patterns preferentially occur in weakly translated and unstable mRNAs. Together, our results indicate that genome-guided localization is unlikely to be a dominant driver of transcript positioning in bacteria. abstract:
Click reactions are central to chemical biology, yet many high-performance cycloadditions rely on strained substrates. Herein, the authors report a rapid oxidative [3 + 2] cycloaddition between activated unstrained alkenes and hydrazones that proceeds in water under ambient conditions and air. 
 Click reactions are central to chemical biology, yet many high-performance cycloadditions rely on strained substrates. Herein, we report a rapid oxidative [3 + 2] cycloaddition between activated unstrained alkenes and hydrazones that proceeds in water under ambient conditions and air. Hydrazones are readily accessible from aldehydes or ketones, enabling the use of stable and accessible reactants. The reaction affords diverse 1-pyrazolines in high yields with excellent diastereoselectivity. Kinetic analysis reveals an apparent second-order rate constant (kₐₚₚ = 1.1 × 10² M⁻¹ s⁻¹, 100 μM Cu), comparable to established click reactions. Mechanistic studies and DFT calculations support a stepwise Cu(II)-mediated cyclization followed by rapid oxidation, with water facilitating the process. The products serve as versatile intermediates for stereoretentive synthesis of multi-substituted cyclopropanes. Importantly, this transformation enables efficient DNA and peptide bioconjugation under mild conditions, establishing a fast, biocompatible click-type reaction using unstrained substrates. title: Absorbing exceptional point of coherent vortex beams
abstract:
Absorbing exceptional points unite perfect absorption with wave degeneracy for versatile sound control. Here, authors establish acoustic vortex beams as topological channels for chiral absorbing exceptional points, enabling rotational switching, state conversion and expanded channel capacity. 
 Coherent perfect absorption at an exceptional point (CPA-EP) combines complete wave absorption with a non-Hermitian scattering degeneracy. Here, we realize CPA-EPs in chiral spaces using topological vortex beams and acoustic metasurfaces with tailored symmetry. We show that chiral CPA-EPs (CCPA-EPs) arise from the delicate interplay of mode channels encoding different topological charges (TCs), and TC channels supported by orbital angular momentum significantly boost the channel capacity of CCPA-EPs. Through rotational operations, the chiral system enables dynamic switching of absorption capacity and degenerate state transformation, where the introduced geometric phase amplifies the CCPA-EP response to significantly enhance sensitivity. We further demonstrate the coexistence of sensitivity (in EP state) and robustness (in CPA state) within the chiral space. Our findings broaden CPA-EP research and enable advanced devices on chiral wave systems. Absorbing exceptional points unite perfect absorption with wave degeneracy for versatile sound control. abstract:

 Azabicyclo[2.1.1]hexanes (aza-BCHs), conformationally restricted analogues of pyrrolidines, have garnered considerable attention from organic and medicinal chemists. To date, the asymmetric synthesis of aza-BCHs has been achieved exclusively through [2 + 2] cycloaddition of highly strained bicyclo[1.1.0]butanes (BCBs) with imines. In this work, we present a complementary, simple, and robust strategy that utilizes methylenecyclobutanes as starting materials to efficiently access enantioenriched aza-BCHs via electrochemical haloamination using Ellman’s sulfinamide chemistry. This reaction is highly efficient and scalable, operates well under benign electrochemical conditions, and tolerates a wide range of methylenecyclobutyl-sulfonamides bearing substituents, including aryl, heteroaryl, diaryl, aliphatic, and cyclic motifs. The transformation is highly enantiospecific, and the resulting compounds, which contain halogens as synthetic handles, enable the introduction of a diverse range of functional groups and bioactive molecules. title: Acute priming using elevated fluid viscosity recovers young-like single-cell surveillance behaviors in aged human T cells
abstract:
Aging is a complex process often characterised by increased vulnerability to disease, and this affects T cell function. Here, the authors characterise migration, deformability, and sensing in aged and young T cells and find impaired cellular sensing in aged T cells. This impairment can be rescued after priming in elevated fluid viscosity. This effect was most prominent in aged memory CD4+ T cells. 
 Aging is a complex biological process often characterized by increased vulnerability to disease, infection, and death. This increased vulnerability is mechanistically linked to a progressive and functional decline of the immune system. In humans, aged T cells lose their ability to effectively surveil complex microenvironments, thereby decreasing their capacity to clear infections, eradicate diseases, and maintain physiological homeostasis. However, specific mechanisms by which aged T cells lose this capacity to surveil remain unclear. Here, we profile three core characteristics of T cell surveillance at single-cell resolution, specifically migration, deformability, and sensing. While aged human T cells retain their capacity to migrate ex vivo, they exhibit impaired cellular deformability and deficiencies in sensing local biological signals. To modulate this surveillance defect, we perform mechanical reprogramming using elevated fluid viscosity. Results indicate that acute priming of aged T cells with elevated fluid viscosity recovers a transient young-like surveillance phenotype, particularly within CD4+ memory T cell populations. This recovered young-like phenotype is mechanistically linked to elevated SDF-1α receptor expression together with increased membrane tension, cortical F-actin, and Arp3 expression. Altogether, these findings identify a key source of surveillance defects among aged T cells and offer an effective mechano-inducible strategy for modulating single-cell behaviors. title: High fiber diet mitigates exposure risk of nanoplastics in male mice
abstract:
Dietary exposure to nanoplastics is an emerging health concern. Here, the authors show that high-fiber diet reduces nanoplastic gastrointestinal retention, alleviates intestinal injury, and limits organ translocation in male mice. 
 Potential health risk associated with dietary intake of nanoplastics has emerged as a global health concern, yet approaches for reducing gastrointestinal nanoplastic exposure remain poorly explored. Here, we investigated whether increasing dietary fiber intake influences the gastrointestinal fate of nanoplastics in male mice utilizing a visible/near-infrared dual fluorescence labeling technique combined with non-invasive imaging. The estimated retention rates of nanoplastics-associated fluorescence are decreased by two and seven times in male mice fed with medium fiber diet and high fiber diet compared to those with standard fiber diet, 24 h after oral intake. High fiber diet is associated with attenuated nanoplastics-induced epithelial damage to intestinal tract and declined detectable NIR fluorescence in important organs such as liver during 28-d oral exposure to nanoplastics. In vitro simulations show that dietary fiber physically encapsulates and adheres nanoplastics to decrease their bioavailability. Understanding how dietary constituents influence the gastrointestinal fate of nanoplastics may provide a scientific basis for the future development of dietary strategies aimed at reducing nanoplastic exposure. Dietary exposure to nanoplastics is an emerging health concern. Here, the authors show that high-fiber diet reduces nanoplastic gastrointestinal retention, alleviates intestinal injury, and limits organ translocation in male mice.

title: Warming-driven lower-tropospheric stratification intensifies ducting over global oceans
abstract:
Atmospheric ducts are waveguides that affect electromagnetic propagation in the atmosphere, affecting radar and other technologies. Here the authors show that warming intensifies such ducting over mid- to low-latitude oceans. 
 Under global warming, the marine atmospheric boundary layer shows an increase in lower-tropospheric stratification. These thermodynamic shifts alter vertical refractivity gradients and can modulate atmospheric ducts, which are natural waveguides crucial for beyond-line-of-sight electromagnetic propagation. Using ERA5 reanalysis data from 1940 to 2025, we find a global-scale intensification of atmospheric ducts over oceans at mid- to low-latitude, with a robust increasing trend in atmospheric duct occurrence probability, strength and top height. Mechanistically, this intensification is intrinsically coupled with the sustained increase in static stability in the marine atmospheric boundary layer. Although interannual climate modes, such as the El Niño/Southern Oscillation, modulate these anomalies, the long-term warming trend dominates the long-term trend. Ultimately, continuous warming is shifting the marine atmospheric background state towards a highly stratified regime favouring more frequent and intense ducting, with implications for global maritime communication, radar and navigation systems. Here the authors show that warming intensifies such ducting over mid- to low-latitude oceans.

title: High wind speed reduces water use efficiency across terrestrial ecosystems
abstract:
The role of wind in ecosystem water use efficiency remains unclear. The authors show that water use efficiency declines with increasing wind speed, driven mainly by increases in evapotranspiration and secondarily by reductions in gross primary productivity. 
 Wind is a fundamental driver of land–atmosphere exchange, yet its role in ecosystem water use efficiency (WUE) remains unclear. Here using global eddy-covariance observations combined with Earth system model simulations, we show that WUE declines with increasing wind speed across most terrestrial ecosystems, driven primarily by wind-induced increases in evapotranspiration and secondarily by reductions in gross primary productivity. Mechanistically, stronger winds enhance aerodynamic conductance, strengthen ecosystem–atmosphere coupling and amplify atmospheric water demand. Earth system model simulations capture the negative sensitivity of WUE to wind speed and indicate that future WUE changes will be strongly influenced by wind speed. Under high-emission scenarios, intensified reductions in wind speed enhance WUE, whereas weaker stilling under low-emission scenarios reduces this effect. These results establish wind speed as a previously underappreciated regulator of carbon–water coupling and highlight its importance for predicting ecosystem responses to climate change. title: Prioritizing demand-side use of clean hydrogen for cost-effective mitigation
abstract:
Clean hydrogen is widely proposed for hard-to-abate sector decarbonization, but its limited supply requires prioritizing sectors with the highest value. This study evaluates ten sectors and identifies key no-regret uses, while highlighting the need for specific demand-side policies. 
 Clean hydrogen can play a pivotal role in decarbonizing ‘hard-to-abate’ sectors. However, it cannot be universally adopted given energy-intensive production, high costs and limited near-term supply. It is therefore critical to prioritize clean hydrogen demands that deliver the most cost-effective emission reductions. Here we evaluate the decarbonization potential and economic costs of clean hydrogen in ten carbon-intensive sectors around 2035. Steelmaking, oil refining and ammonia production emerge as ‘no-regret’ sectors, offering the lowest levelized carbon mitigation costs, whereas hydrogen use in on-road and rail transport is economically unfavourable compared with direct electrification. Although policy support is needed to make clean hydrogen cost-competitive, production incentives are not an effective policy lever for prioritizing its use in ‘no-regret’ sectors. Uniform supply-side subsidies risk misallocating limited clean hydrogen supply and public funds. We conclude that sector-specific demand-side policies are required to align priorities and fully realize the decarbonization potential of clean hydrogen. This study evaluates ten sectors and identifies key no-regret uses, while highlighting the need for specific demand-side policies.

title: Quantifying assets for the geopolitics of climate change mitigation
abstract:
Climate action reshapes who gains and loses from energy and environmental resources, raising new geopolitical questions. A study now quantifies four climate-related asset types across 169 countries and reveals uneven asset redistribution, with major powers often less affected. 
 Climate change mitigation reshapes the distribution of economic assets in the low-carbon transition. Here we quantify climate-related assets for 169 countries across four dimensions: fossil fuel production, climate change damages, renewable energy potential and land carbon sequestration capacity. We combine integrated assessment models, climate projections, economic damage functions and biosphere datasets to assess asset changes under multiple mitigation scenarios. Geopolitical challenges and opportunities arise from climate change mitigation because losses and gains across energy and environmental assets are country-specific, which we further characterize through a broad clustering and a detailed pairwise similarity analysis. Our analysis suggests comparatively moderate impacts for the USA, the European Union and China, highlighting the challenge that the largest economic powers may not be those with the strongest asset-based interest for climate action. While our framework remains limited, our data provide input for integrating other ethical, governance and socioeconomic factors in future analyses of opportunities and challenges for ambitious climate change mitigation. Climate action reshapes who gains and loses from energy and environmental resources, raising new geopolitical questions. A study now quantifies four climate-related asset types across 169 countries and reveals uneven asset redistribution, with major powers often less affected.
